titles.title: Ghost Ranch Cliffs

description: Tall, chalky yellow cliffs stand above bright red hills populated with green trees. The hills rise on either side of the composition, creating a V-shape on the left side of the image. A triangle of clear blue sky is visible beyond the cliffs.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
